title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. My wife before our marriage had made an niyath to keep nafl fast on monday and thursday after our nikah for the rest of her life. But due to some reasons she is not able to keep it regularly. Hence she skips it sometimes. I like to know is there is any alternative for the niyath she has made as per Islamic shariah. Kindly reply at the earliest because since missing of fast makes both of us feel guilty and we are not able to overcome that. 5341 views Q. Kaffaaraah for 2 Months Fasts 2811 views Q. Swear(KASAM) of Allah 14487 views Q. Minnat for 40 fasts 2222 views Q. Please advise how can we keep promise 1856 views Q. Asslamwalaikum brother I made niyat to fast full life on monday/thursday but sometime due to work pressure or health issues, i cant do it but weekly once i do that for sure. Am i sinful or have to make kaffara or what please advice... 2155 views Q. As-salam-alakum, I want to ask that I love my cousin since 1998. I prayed to Allah and dua if I get married with her I will go for 4months in Jamat. This is my first mannat. After sometime I changed my mannat saying I will do one month Ayetkaaf. But she got married to someone. After one year, she got divorced from him. Then I tried to get married with her but could not. After soemtime I got married with someone else. After one year I also got divorced from her. Now I'm getting married with my cousin for whom I made dua's to Allah with mannat. Now, it?s second marriage for both of us. I do a job in BPO so it?s not possible for me to get four month or one month leave if any one of these conditions to be fulfilled. Please tell me if the mannat is wajib on me and if it?s wajib how I can fulfill this or any one of these. My company will not permit me to take one month or four moth leave. now a days it's hard to get a job. Please Tell me if there is any other way to fulfill this mannat. Please give me the best solution for this. Please remember both of us in your dua to Allah for happy life. Regards! 2790 views Q. Assalam alaikum. My question is if a husband takes a kasam of allah in anger that for a particular time duration he will not have humbistari with his wife and if he breaks it by doing so. what is the thing/amal that he can do to correct this? 3582 views Q. Kya islaam mai mannat mangna haraam hai shirk hai? or kya baqra eid per nar baqre ki qurbani karna haraam hai jabki muje maloom hua hai ki haj ke duraan nar baqre ki hi qurbani di jati hai. 13414 views Q. One of my mom's friends is constantly making excessive minnats (for example, I will pray 200 salat-ut-tasbeeh, or finish the quran 50 times if such and such a thing happens). After the her duaa is accepted and the event happens she is unable to fulfill her minnat and almost forces my mom to help her fulfill it; for example, you read quran 40 times, I'll read it 10 times. Because the person is asking you to do a good deed you cannot refuse it, but it is also difficult to carry out the minnat within the period of time the friend gives. For this reason I was wondering if it is alright to tell the person to 1. not make such excessive minnats that you can't fulfill yourself 2. to pray or carry out the good deed before you make the duaa (since making minnat is sort of like playing with allah). Question: AS-SALAAM-O-ALAIKUM mufti sahab. I saw a dream i want to know the exact tabeer because this really worried me. i make a istikhara for the person which i liked him by mufti and by myself and the answer is come"yes" one day on some matter we fight with another and next day i loose my temper and on in that condition i pick a quran on my hand and swear with quran that i will never get married with him..on that night when i slept i saw a dream and the dream is" first i saw masjid nabvi and then i saw makkah i stand infront of makkah which is very near to me.. then i pray to ALLAH that oh ALLAH please give me "a"(i call the name of person which i liked him)and then i closed my eyes after a second when i open my eyes then makkah is dissapear i got so much worried and cried bitterly and says in my heart that its mean i make big sin thats why ALLAH will never forgive me then suddenly a voice with a white light is come that dont worry it will come in evening,,please tell me the tabeer of this dream i am really oblige to you,,thanks Answer ID: 7575 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1552/1469=D /1429) You should do istikhara again for marrying the boy mentioned above; also consult the Mufti sahib mentioned in the question. If it appears good to tie the knot in view of Istikhara and consultation, then you should marry in order to get chastity with your consent of your parents. You have to give expiation for your swearing of not marrying, and you have to pay it after you will marry him when your swearing will be broken because of marriage with him. The expiation for swearing is to feed ten poor people two times to their hearts content, or give 1.633 kg wheat to ten poor or ten sewn clothes to ten poor people. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
